# DreamFX

> DreamFX is an Unreal Engine plugin that generates Niagara systems, emitters and modules from text sources written in DreamFXLang (.dfs systems, .dfe reusable emitters, .dfm modules and dynamic inputs).

DreamFXLang is its own language, not HLSL or C++. Module input names come from the real Niagara assets, so look a module's inputs up (`dfx.ps1 schema <Module>`) instead of guessing them. Read the cheat sheet before writing a source.

Every diagnostic carries a code `DFXnnnn` with a line and a column. diagnostics.json lists each code with its severity, stage, message, meaning, fix and documentation link.

llms-full.txt holds the cheat sheet and the whole language reference in one file.

## Start here

- [Cheat sheet](https://fx.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/start/cheatsheet/): the language on one page; its complete system is built by the plugin's gate
- [The full language reference](https://fx.toolchain.64hz.cn/llms-full.txt): cheat sheet and every language page in one text file
- [Diagnostics as JSON](https://fx.toolchain.64hz.cn/diagnostics.json): every DFXnnnn: severity, stage, title, meaning, fix, doc

## Language

- [The file model](https://fx.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/language/overview/): the language at a glance
- [.dfs — a system](https://fx.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/language/dfs/): .dfs systems: settings, user parameters, stacks, renderers
- [.dfe — a reusable emitter](https://fx.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/language/dfe/): .dfe reusable emitters
- [.dfm — modules and dynamic inputs](https://fx.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/language/dfm/): .dfm modules and dynamic inputs
- [Values, types and rules](https://fx.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/language/values/): literals, links, dynamic inputs, hlsl, curves, expressions, types
- [Events and simulation stages](https://fx.toolchain.64hz.cn/en/docs/language/events-and-stages/): event handlers and simulation stages
